objective: Connected block: discriminate graphic types by internal strokes, contacts and orientation; audit whether existing visual sample is appropriate to a phonetic Sumerian inventory; test revised criteria on separate images.
text_layer: No individual transliterations, translations, dictionary sign names or phonetic values to be opened.
metadata_status: Modern catalogue assertions, not independently established chronology or language identification. Not used to assign sounds.
stages: metadata-only audit of already studied photographs
new sample selected using nonsemantic date/language/image criteria with image criteria frozen before viewing
update inventory with explicit retain/split/unknown decisions, complete report and atlas
limits: Avoid treating different periods as one homogeneous alphabet
Keep image-only observations separate from dating/language labels
No independent sound decipherment claim without evidence
Whole connected cycle, no stopping after one technical step
